description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'sugar_evalcolumn' used to evaluate and render data within SugarCRM's ListView templates. It handles substitution of field data into custom code snippets, supporting dynamic content rendering with parameters like tabindex and accesskey, and integrates with SugarCRM's field and connector utilities.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_evalcolumn
methods.description: Evaluates a string by substituting field data and rendering custom code snippets in ListViews, supporting dynamic attributes and connector integration.
